correctness.rationale: A uniform value-order bijection maps forced-succession permutations to b! block orders; every cross-block inverted pair contributes the product of its block lengths. Independent uniform ranks induce this order. A direct linear-residual Hoeffding projection gives all weighted-inversion covariance terms, with residual variance 1/12 and zero pairwise cross terms. The single-run variance and extremes follow by substitution. The endpoint independent rank insertion establishes the claimed uniform weak limit; central L2 vanishing follows from the exact bound. The actual standalone verifier passed 505 exact assertions for n through 9 as specified.

value.rationale: Prescribed increasing-value runs are natural shuffle-test features, and Kendall inversion is a natural rank-distance score. The derived full conditional law quantitatively links them. Most strikingly, identical conditional inversion means conceal an exact parabolic variance that changes the macroscopic fluctuation scale by a factor of n between endpoint and central run placements, with a non-Gaussian uniform endpoint limit. This is a structural conditional-null phenomenon, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a re-tabulation of known marginal succession counts.
